skills.name: Active Listening
skills.description: Attentively interpreting another person's spoken message, confirming understanding and responding appropriately.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.description: Evaluating claims, assumptions and available evidence to reach a reasoned conclusion.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.description: Communicating information and ideas orally with clarity and attention to the audience.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.description: Understanding and interpreting written instructions, documents and arguments.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.description: Tracking progress or changing conditions against criteria and recognizing when corrective action is needed.

skills.name: Writing
skills.description: Expressing ideas clearly in written form for a defined audience and purpose.

skills.name: Active Learning
skills.description: Applying newly acquired information and feedback to solve unfamiliar problems and update one's approach.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.description: Noticing relevant social cues and considering how others may interpret an interaction.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.description: Adjusting one's work and timing in relation to other people's actions to achieve a shared objective.

skills.name: Service Orientation
skills.description: Recognizing a person's needs and responding in a helpful, appropriate and respectful way.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.description: Comparing alternatives, trade-offs and possible consequences before making a decision.

skills.name: Complex Problem Solving
skills.description: Defining complex problems, considering constraints and evaluating potential solutions.

skills.name: Learning Strategies
skills.description: Selecting and adapting methods that make instruction, study or practice more effective.

skills.name: Instructing
skills.description: Explaining and demonstrating concepts or procedures and checking another person's understanding.

skills.name: Time Management
skills.description: Prioritizing work and allocating limited time to meet goals and deadlines.

skills.name: Mathematics
skills.description: Applying mathematical principles and quantitative reasoning to solve appropriate problems.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.description: Presenting reasons and evidence to influence a decision ethically while respecting the other person's agency.
